title: Bologna Children’s Book Fair 2025
excerpt: Our second year with our own stand in Bologna, joined by our authors Ahmet Coşkun, Ezo Sunal and Özlem Fedai Korçak for talks and a workshop.
image_alt: The Epsilon Publishing Group team at our stand, Bologna Children’s Book Fair 2025
body:
We [returned to the Bologna Children’s Book Fair](/news/bologna-childrens-book-fair-2024/) on 31 March–3 April 2025 with our own stand, more experience and some special company: our authors. Alongside a busy schedule of rights meetings, events at the Türkiye collective stand brought their work to life. [Ahmet Coşkun](/authors/ahmet-coskun/), author of [Kaya Dişler Ülkesi’nde](/books/kaya-disler-ulkesinde/) (Kaya in the Land of Teeth), gave a talk titled “The Key to Children’s Oral Health”, while [Ezo Sunal](/authors/ezo-sunal/), whose list includes more than ten titles published under our [Masalperest](/publishers/masalperest/) imprint, presented “Stories and Lullabies that Outgrow Their Shell”. [Özlem Fedai Korçak](/authors/ozlem-fedai-korcak/), author and illustrator of our much-loved Monsters series, also joined us with her “Mini Bookmaking Workshop”.

Sharing Bologna with our creators added a new dimension to our second year as exhibitors, allowing international colleagues to meet the people behind the books. We left with fresh inspiration, renewed motivation and plenty to build on as preparations for our next fair began.
